title: AstraDB component Ingest all items twice
body:
As I run the flow to ingest data, it does it twice. So each item is captured twice in the AstraDB data collection. 

**Browser and Version**
- Langflow version 1.0.6 running on local a virtual environment

**To Reproduce**
- use the pre-built flow 'Vector Store RAG'
- use the existing flow to ingest any content

Does anyone that experience the same?

linked_prs.title: fix: astradb ingests twice
linked_prs.body:
Already fixed by https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/2455
but during a conflict resolution it has been partially reverted

Fixes #2552

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This issue describes a workflow anomaly where the agent's flow ingests data twice, leading to repeated actions. Workflow anomalies like hanging, loops, or repeated tasks are explicitly categorized as agent issues under the taxonomy.
